name: rosetta-truncate-a-file
code:
use default
use IO

truncate(path: string, length: long) is
    if !IO.File.exists(path) then
        throw System.Exception("no such file: {path}")
    fi

    let current = IO.File.read_all_bytes(path).count

    if length >= cast(current) then
        throw System.Exception(
            "length {length} is not less than the current length {current}")
    fi

    let stream = FileStream(path, FileMode.OPEN, FileAccess.WRITE)
    stream.set_length(length)
    stream.dispose()
si

let path = "sample.bin"

IO.File.write_all_bytes(path, [0ub, 1ub, 2ub, 3ub, 4ub, 5ub, 6ub, 7ub])

truncate(path, 4L)

write_line("{IO.File.read_all_bytes(path) |> join(" ")}")

try
    truncate("missing.bin", 1L)
catch e: System.Exception
    write_line(e.message)
yrt

try
    truncate(path, 4L)
catch e: System.Exception
    write_line(e.message)
yrt

IO.File.delete(path)
